name: Bubba's boxing IG - 'Fighters & trainers are 1099' (EN)
demand_trigger: Trainers, coaches and fighters are independent contractors with no employer plan; 2027 Open Enrollment Nov 1 - Jan 15
content_concept: 3-frame IG Story with link sticker (frame 1 hook, frame 2 the Dec 15 date, frame 3 CTA) + 1 talking-head Reel with the link in bio. Bubba on camera, real gym.
offer_cta: Tap the link: free 60-second 2027 Health Coverage Check (Florida). See your enrollment window and whether you're in the range for help paying premiums.
hypothesis: An audience that already trusts Bubba, made mostly of 1099 workers, will start the Check from a Story link; Florida share of the audience decides whether completions turn into phone leads.

name: AI explainer (Spanish, labeled AI) - '¿Trabajas por tu cuenta?' shorts
demand_trigger: New 1099 work (beauty, barber, real estate, trucking, new businesses) concentrated in Miami-Dade; 2027 Open Enrollment
content_concept: 5 vertical 20-30s Spanish shorts, one question each, presented by an AI-generated presenter labeled on screen 'Presentadora generada con IA' (plus the platform AI label). New dedicated Instagram account (bio link works from day one); the same files cross-posted to TikTok and YouTube Shorts for reach.
offer_cta: Haz el chequeo gratis de 60 segundos. Link en el perfil.
hypothesis: Spanish-language, question-led explainers reach Miami-Dade self-employed people that English content misses; a clearly labeled AI presenter can produce enough reach from a new account to send real visitors.

name: Google Search micro-test - self-employed / Obamacare 2027 (EN + ES ad groups)
demand_trigger: People actively searching for individual/self-employed health insurance during the 2027 enrollment window
content_concept: Two exact/phrase-match ad groups (EN, ES) geo-targeted to Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach. Text ads, no $0 claims, no government look.
offer_cta: Free 2027 Health Coverage Check - see your enrollment window in 60 seconds. / Chequeo gratis de cobertura 2027 en 60 segundos.
hypothesis: High-intent search traffic converts to phone submissions at a rate that makes cost per consented phone lead lower than what an agent pays per lead.
